description: This is a Python source file defining the AssetCategory document class and associated functions for managing asset categories within an ERP system. It includes validation methods for finance books, account types, currencies, and capital work-in-progress accounts, as well as a utility function for retrieving asset category accounts.

classes.name: AssetCategory
classes.description: Represents an asset category document with validation logic for finance books, accounts, and account currency consistency.

methods.name: validate(self)
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the asset category data before saving.

methods.name: validate_finance_books(self)
methods.description: Ensures that finance book entries have total depreciation counts and frequencies greater than zero.

methods.name: validate_account_currency(self)
methods.description: Verifies that all account currencies match the company's default currency.

methods.name: validate_account_types(self)
methods.description: Checks that accounts associated with the asset category are of the expected account types.

methods.name: valide_cwip_account(self)
methods.description: Ensures that CWIP accounts are set if CWIP accounting is enabled, or suggests linking to default CWIP accounts.

methods.name: get_asset_category_account(fieldname, item=None, asset=None, account=None, asset_category = None, company = None)

ctags.name: get_asset_category_account
ctags.signature: (fieldname, item=None, asset=None, account=None, asset_category = None, company = None)
